title: Microsoft says it is on pace to invest $50B by 2030 to help expand AI across the "Global South"; it unveiled $17.5B worth of AI investments in India in 2025 (Abu Sultan/Reuters)
summary: Abu Sultan / Reuters: Microsoft says it is on pace to invest $50B by 2030 to help expand AI across the “Global South”; it unveiled $17.5B worth of AI investments in India in 2025 — Microsoft (MSFT.O) on Wednesday said it is on pace to invest $50 billion by the end of the decade to help expand AI to countries across the ‘Global South’.
contentText:
Abu Sultan / Reuters :

Microsoft says it is on pace to invest $50B by 2030 to help expand AI across the “Global South”; it unveiled $17.5B worth of AI investments in India in 2025   —  Microsoft (MSFT.O) on Wednesday said it is on pace to invest $50 billion by the end of the decade to help expand AI to countries across the ‘Global South’.
